# Copilot General Instructions

These instructions apply to this repository.

## Project Context
- This is a course project using JSP pages.
- Tomcat helper tasks are provided in `.vscode/`.

## Coding Guidelines
- Prefer simple, readable JSP and HTML.
- Keep changes minimal and scoped to the user request.
- Preserve existing file and folder structure.
- Use clear naming and concise comments only when needed.
- Do not add dependencies unless explicitly requested.

## JSP Guidelines
- Prefer EL/JSTL patterns over heavy Java scriptlets when possible.
- Keep business logic out of JSP pages.
- Keep markup valid and easy for beginners to follow.
- Preserve compatibility with a standard Tomcat setup.

## Safe Change Rules
- Do not modify deployment or Tomcat scripts unless asked.
- Do not rename or move files unless asked.
- Do not remove user content or assignment text.

## Run and Verify
- Use the existing VS Code tasks when running locally:
  - `Deploy JSP to Tomcat ROOT`
  - `Start Tomcat (JPDA)`
  - `Stop Tomcat`
- After edits, verify JSP syntax and basic render behavior.

## Response Style
- Explain what changed and why in plain language.
- Reference exact file paths for all edits.
- If assumptions are made, state them clearly.

## Documentation Requirements
- Put your name, the date, and the assignment name/number as a comment near the top of each source code file.
- State the purpose of the code in one short sentence or phrase as a comment near the top of each course code file.
- Use descriptive variable names and method names.
- Add comments when the purpose of code is not clear. In most cases, include comments for each main block of code.
- Give credit to the original source if code is borrowed from elsewhere.
- Refer to the Academic Honesty Policy in Bellevue University Policies for BU plagiarism guidance.
- Cite all sources. Give credit when code is borrowed from elsewhere or generated by AI.

## Formatting Suggestions
- Leave blank lines between main sections of code, similar to paragraphs in an essay.
- Properly indent blocks of code.
